links.outcome: Hallucinations in LLM-generated radiology reports and synthetic medical images
links.effect: Common patterns of hallucination (factual inconsistencies, anatomical inaccuracies) found in both image-to-text and text-to-image tasks; no numeric results reported in abstract.
links.quote: Our findings reveal common patterns of hallucination in both interpretive and generative tasks, with implications for clinical reliability.

screen.reason: Empirical benchmarking study characterizing error patterns and hallucinations across modalities in multimodal LLMs for medical imaging, but does not test an organizational deployment guardrail or practice.
